About
Australian actor, musician, and model who landed the role of Ben Kirk on the long-running soap opera Neighbours. In 2018, he'd begin playing Cooper James in the CBS comedy Happy Together.
Before Fame
He first appeared on Neighbours in an episode that premiered in June of 2014.
Trivia
He earned representation from Vivien Models out of Melbourne, Australia.
Family Life
He has a sister.
Associated With
He starred alongside Lilly Van Der Meer on Neighbours.
